This gives the user the ability to provide default values, value, add information like connection url, project based configuration value and also provide data types of each parameter.

snapshotNumber.description: Optional. An increasing sequence that is set when a new snapshot is created. The last created snapshot can be identified by [workflow_name, org_id latest(snapshot_number)]. However, last created snapshot need not be same as the HEAD. So users should always use "HEAD" tag to identify the head.

errorCatcherConfigs.description: Optional. Error Catch Task configuration for the integration. It's optional.

taskConfigs.description: Optional. Task configuration for the integration. It's optional, but the integration doesn't do anything without task_configs.

value.description: Values for the defined keys. Each value can either be string, int, double or any proto message or a serialized object.

parameter.description: Optional. Integration Parameter to provide the default value, data type and attributes required for the Integration config variables.

GoogleCloudIntegrationsV2DuetIntegration.description: Integration Config Parameter is defined in the integration config and are used to provide external configuration for integration. It provide information about data types of the expected parameters and provide any default values or value. They can also be used to add custom attributes.

taskNumber.description: The task number associated with this execution.

task.description: The task name associated with this execution.

privateIntegrationName.description: Optional. The direct integration which the execution belongs to.

taskAttempt.description: The task attempt number this execution belongs to.

ancestorIterationNumbers.description: Optional. Ancestor iteration number for the task (it will only be non-empty if the task is under 'private integration').

ancestorTaskNumbers.description: Optional. Ancestor task number for the task (it will only be non-empty if the task is under 'private integration').

executionAttempt.description: The execution attempt number this execution belongs to.

taskLabel.description: The task label associated with this execution.

startTime.description: The start time of the execution for the current attempt. This could be in the future if it's been scheduled.

endTime.description: The end time of the execution for the current attempt.

GoogleCloudIntegrationsV2DuetGenerateJav.description: Response message containing generated Javascript code recommendations.

EnterpriseCrmEventbusProtoAddress.description: Email address along with optional name and tokens. These tokens will be substituted for the variables in the form of [{var_name}], where var_name could be any string of no more than 32 bytes.

taskExecutionMetadata.description: Optional. Metadata of the task execution.

variables.description: Optional. Variables used during the execution.

GoogleCloudIntegrationsV2TaskExecution.description: Execution of a single task within an integration

EnterpriseCrmEventbusProtoParameterMapFi.description: Field represents either the key or value in an entry.

referenceKey.description: Referencing one of the WF variables.

rootCause.description: Root cause of the integration execution failure.

detailedExplanation.description: Detailed explanation of the root cause of the integration execution failure.

displayMessage.description: Display message to be shown to the user. Example - If integration execution succeeded, this field value can be "Integration execution succeeded. No troubleshooting needed.".

errorMessage.description: Error message of the integration execution, if the execution failed.

executionId.description: The execution id of the integration execution to be troubleshooted.

GoogleCloudIntegrationsV2DuetTroubleshoo.description: Response for troubleshooting an integration execution.

integrationVersion.description: The integration version containing basic triggers and tasks.

explanation.description: Explanation of why this integration was generated.

tag.description: Indicate the strategy/methodology used to generate the integration.

GoogleCloudIntegrationsV2DuetIntegration.description: An integration skeleton containing basic fields which can be used to create an integration on the UI.

quotaUser.description: Available to use for quota purposes for server-side applications. Can be any arbitrary string assigned to a user, but should not exceed 40 characters.

fields.description: Selector specifying which fields to include in a partial response.

oauth_token.description: OAuth 2.0 token for the current user.

key.description: API key. Your API key identifies your project and provides you with API access, quota, and reports. Required unless you provide an OAuth 2.0 token.
